title: THREE BODIES THAT READ
why: His order of 2026-10-12, make them all look better, and his answer 24: redesign the silhouettes for readability first. At raid size Lean and Broad were the same person. Broad now stands on wider legs and bigger boots, one fifth wider, with a thicker arm on the gun, so a Broad body reads heavy from across the room. Lean wears the plate carrier on a slimmer torso, 11 wide where it was 13, with a slimmer arm. Curved keeps her outline, her rig cut to it and her jiggle. Suits keep their own figure.
now: Lean, Broad and Curved now look like three different bodies at raid size.

edits.replacement: if(_BLD){ buildPath(x+leanX,ty,(_BLD==='broad')?BUILD_BROAD:BUILD_CURVED,0); wc.fill(); } else if(_PC) wc.fillRect(x-5.6+leanX,ty-22,11.2,11); else wc.fillRect(x-6.5+leanX,ty-22,13,11);

edits.anchor: wc.fillStyle=coat; if(_BLD==='broad') wc.fillRect(1+ext,-2.9,6,5.8); else if(_BLD==='curved') wc.fillRect(1+ext,-2.0,6,4.0); else wc.fillRect(1+ext,-2.4,6,4.8);
edits.replacement: wc.fillStyle=coat; if(_BLD==='broad') wc.fillRect(1+ext,-3.3,6,6.6); else if(_BLD==='curved') wc.fillRect(1+ext,-2.0,6,4.0); else if(_PC) wc.fillRect(1+ext,-2.1,6,4.2); else wc.fillRect(1+ext,-2.4,6,4.8);   /* v23.xx (spr16): Broad thicker, Lean slimmer */
